units.source_text: 姑娘朝西边走，再折回御旅所。

en.t: The girl walked toward the west, then turned back to the otabisho.

units.source_text: 千重子则相反，朝东边走，然后再折回来。

en.t: Chieko did the opposite, walking toward the east and then turning back again.

units.source_text: 但是，那位姑娘比千重子更虔诚，祷告时间也长。

en.t: But that girl was more devout than Chieko, and her prayer lasted longer.
